name: init_profile
description: Scaffold a new personal or team profile repo from llm-agent-framework templates.

profile_type.description: Which profile template set to scaffold from.

target_path.description: Absolute path where the new profile repo will be created.

infrastructure_path.description: Absolute path to the llm-agent-framework infrastructure repo.

git_init.description: Whether to run git init at the target path after scaffolding.

project_path.description: Optional: project root to write .llm-framework.yml to after scaffolding.
